英譯中：請將下列英文翻譯成中文（每小題 15 分，共 30 分）
① To many people around the world, “hula” may conjure images of plasticdancers shaking their hips on car dashboards. But long before hula wascommodified, it was a sacred dance among Native Hawaiians – an ancientpractice that served as an archive of their stories, beliefs and way of life.There was no written language in ancient Hawai'i. Instead, the Hawaiiansused oral tradition and hula to pass on their identity and culture from onegeneration to the next.
② In 1869, three central New York women led the National Woman SuffrageAssociation (NWSA) for women’s voting rights. Elizabeth Candy Stanton,an organizer of the 1848 women’s rights convention, and activist Susan B.Anthony are well-known. The third, Matilda Josyn Cage, was almostforgotten due to her radicalism. Unlike the other two, Gage aimed to extendhuman rights to all Americans, including Black and Indigenousindividuals.

中譯英：請將下列中文翻譯成英文（每小題 15 分，共 30 分）
①國際駕照是在大多數外國開車或租車的要求。它也是聯合國監管的旅行證件，以確保您的安全和旅行方便。
②由於強烈颱風來襲，所有公家機關將於 6 月 27 日（星期四）及 6 月28 日（星期五）暫停開放。所有居民應密切注意新聞報導，以掌握最新的天氣動態及安全訊息。我們強烈建議在臺灣訪問的國際旅客與家人及朋友聯繫，向他們報平安。若您有使用社群媒體，請務必更新您的狀態。
英文作文：（40 分）Suppose you could choose one day in a year as a new holiday for the wholeworld to celebrate. What holiday would it be? Please explain why and howyour created holiday should be celebrated.
